description: This file defines a Go struct and associated methods for configuring the status of a HorizontalPodAutoscaler in Kubernetes, including fields for observed generation, last scale time, current and desired replicas, metrics, and conditions.

classes.name: HorizontalPodAutoscalerStatusApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A declarative configuration struct for the HorizontalPodAutoscalerStatus type, used to build configuration objects with chainable 'With' methods.

methods.name: HorizontalPodAutoscalerStatus
methods.description: Constructor function that creates a new instance of HorizontalPodAutoscalerStatusApplyConfiguration.

methods.name: WithObservedGeneration
methods.description: Sets the observed generation in the configuration.

methods.name: WithLastScaleTime
methods.description: Sets the last scale time in the configuration.

methods.name: WithCurrentMetrics
methods.description: Adds metric status configurations to the current metrics list.

methods.name: WithConditions
methods.description: Adds condition configurations to the conditions list.
